scope: Current-client KismetMathLibrary BooleanAND, BooleanOR and Not_PreBool wrappers, local VM truth-table regressions, and static repository IR inventory; not full-card or PvP certification.

capture.method: Read-only machine-code capture. BooleanAND/BooleanOR include both result return paths; Not_PreBool includes its result path. No native function was invoked and no game memory was written.

Not_PreBool.condition_instruction: sete al after comparing the parsed Boolean local with zero

semantics.operand_parsing: BooleanAND and BooleanOR each parse both Boolean parameters before branching to a result path; the wrapper does not skip parsing B based on A.

static_ir_inventory.note: The repository IR snapshot includes non-PvP assets and does not establish current-client reachability or PvP eligibility.

regression.cases: All four BooleanAND/BooleanOR input combinations and both Not_PreBool inputs.
regression.result: All 10 simulator outputs match the captured Boolean contract; no VM faults.

limitations: The evidence covers valid Boolean inputs and observed wrapper paths, not malformed UFunction frames or every property flag.
BotSim tests the local VM; it does not call the client executable for differential runtime testing.
Static IR counts do not establish PvP eligibility, execution reachability, or complete card behavior.
Evidence is valid only when the executable SHA-256 matches the value above.
